summary: iter95y backend testing for color picker moved from sites/Lokalizacje to finance/Budowy. Core flows work (create/sync to sites, propagation on PUT update, omitted color, no sync when show_in_hours=false, GET /api/sites includes color). 2 bugs found: legacy budowy without color field don't expose color=None in GET list; PUT with color=null does NOT clear color (None values filtered out). 6/8 tests pass (75%).

critical.issue: PUT with {"color": null} does NOT clear the color in finance_budowy or in linked construction_sites. Root cause: routes/finance.py line 406 filters out None values via 'if v is not None'. Tests required clearing color via null but backend silently keeps old value (still '#FF5733'). Fix: change filter to allow None for fields like 'color', or special-case it. The propagation to sites IS done (line 427-430) but only runs when 'color' is in upd dict, which never happens because None is filtered.

Legacy budowy (created before iter95y) do NOT include 'color' key in the response at all (Mongo doc lacks field). Spec requires: 'GET zwraca pole color dla wszystkich budow (None dla legacy bez koloru)'. Fix: in list_budowy, post-process rows to ensure each row has 'color' key defaulting to None, OR run a one-time migration setting color=None on legacy docs. Tested doc id: 589dc3b6-3cd9-4e49-9820-0c12fd0f2648 (missing 'color' key entirely).

action_items: Fix PUT /api/finance/budowy/{id} to allow color=null to clear value (do not filter None for 'color' field). Ensure sites.color is also $set to null in same flow.
Fix GET /api/finance/budowy to always include 'color' key (default None) for legacy rows without the field.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/finance.py update_budowa (line 406): blanket 'if v is not None' filter prevents any field from being cleared via explicit null. This breaks not only color but any future Optional field that supports clearing. Consider per-field handling or use exclude_unset only.
routes/finance.py: file is 3233 lines - exceeds 700 line guideline, should be split into smaller modules (budowy.py, zapisy.py, invoices.py, kody.py).
list_budowy projection {'_id': 0} returns rows as-is; no normalization. Recommend projecting/defaulting 'color': {'$ifNull': ['$color', None]} in aggregation, or post-processing rows in Python.
seed_data_creation: Created 7 test budowy prefixed with TEST_95y_<timestamp>_ and linked sites; all cleaned up in fixture teardown via DELETE /api/finance/budowy/{id} and DELETE /api/sites/{id}?permanent=true
context_for_next_testing_agent: iter95y moved color picker from sites/Lokalizacje to finance/Budowy. Backend endpoint is /api/finance/budowy (NOT /api/budowy/finance). Helper _sync_to_sites accepts color param. PUT propagates color to construction_sites via finance_budowa_id link. Re-run /app/backend/tests/test_iter95y_finance_budowa_color.py after main agent fixes the two issues (PUT color=null clearing + GET legacy color=None defaulting).
rca of the issue: 1) PUT color=null fails: update_budowa filters dict comprehension drops all None values, so 'color' never reaches the $set or the sites sync block. 2) GET legacy missing color: MongoDB find() returns doc as-is without imputing missing keys. Both require small backend changes in routes/finance.py.
